summary: Coalesces many same-frame rebuild requests into one rebuild at end of frame.
overview: Five children each requesting a rebuild after their own content changed should not make the shared parent lay out five times in one frame. This collects the requests and does the work once.
useCases: A list where many rows update in the same frame.
Several independent components sharing one layout parent.
Reducing layout cost on a busy UI without restructuring it.

gotchas.title: It is the opposite of the immediate helper
gotchas.body: Use this when many things change and cost is the problem; use the immediate rebuild when you need the size NOW. Mixing them up gives you either a flicker or wasted work.
